bio.text: Ro Khanna has represented California's 17th Congressional District, in Silicon Valley, in the U.S. House since January 2017.
He was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, in 1976, and earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Chicago (1998) and a J.D. from Yale (2001).
He previously worked as an attorney, a professor, and a deputy assistant secretary at the U.S. Department of Commerce.
He is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
